'''''Tritonia laxifolia''''' is a perennial flowering plant belonging to the genus ''[[Tritonia (plant)|Tritonia]]''.<ref>http://redlist.sanbi.org/species.php?species=1537-29 REDLIST Sanbi</ref> In [[South Africa]], the species is endemic to the [[Eastern Cape]] and [[KwaZulu-Natal]] as well as [[Malawi]], [[Mozambique]], [[Tanzania]] and [[Zambia]].<ref>http://plantsoftheworldonline.org/taxon/urn:lsid:ipni.org:names:441711-1 Plants of the World Online</ref>
